method: Reverse 10y DCF (10% disc, 2.5% terminal): implied annual FCF growth the current price requires. FCF/cash in $M, shares in M. Banks/insurers & pre-revenue/negative-FCF names excluded (Oklo, NuScale, IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave, Quantinuum, CoreWeave, Nebius, AST, Hertz).
